text: The purpose of this report is to present the 2025 first quarter financial results to the Board.

The Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Approved the 2025 first quarter financial operating results, as noted in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (May 27, 2025) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (May 27, 2025) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live remain confidential in its entirety as it contains financial information supplied in confidence to the Board of Directors to TO Live, which if disclosed, could reasonably be expected to significantly prejudice the competitive position or significantly interfere with the contractual or other negotiations of a person, group of persons or organization.
